text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio, that parcel you're holding... Could
it be that
you remembered my
birthday? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You got it! I randomly grabbed a heap
of snacks
you like and stuffed them into
this pouch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You picked them at random?! How
irresponsible...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, just so you know, I did a whole
bunch of
thinking at first, but nothing
came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean, I already give you so much.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You see, I'm always training, stressing,
and
getting stronger just so I can race
you. That's
why...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of like I'm already giving
presents to you
every day. Can't beat
that, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I understand now. Indeed... that is a lot
of effort
on your part. All the same, I do
hope that you've
prepared yourself for
what's to come.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've no intention of giving back any
presents I've
received. As such, I think
I'll have you run
alongside me for the
foreseeable future—no
matter the
season, nor how much time passes.
